content: Igaw nisesus Nasalet mo Yon isilamaw nageiguy ven Yudiy wanawoud, mtowen tabibapta̱ysein gamags, ilana, “Bikanavin ninoumiy, sinap kalbaleb kulavewas, peinan Yowbad kakita bisilamaw nakaleiwag.”
Palopit towen Isaya kweiboug nilivnek Yon nawotet, ilana,
Mtowen Yon anakweim wunuwunun kamel, anawat kaleivin kamel, kan gog kulipaw son kitoul.
Mo inounas inekes Yon, min-Yelusalem sisiyas Yudiy gimgilis, sisiyas wunsiyas ven wadadan lay yagan Yoldan, ika̱mats asisinap kalbaleb, Yon mo ibapta̱yses tasiyas lay Yoldan waseg.

Ikin tasiyas Palisiy sisiyas tasiyas Sadusiy imimeis va̱gan bibapta̱yses, mo ika̱nes, ilana, “Mwatet yakamiy, adok teitan tan niguyeimiy mapuna kuwenes Yowbad, amipwa̱yat igaw mo bikatimop amisinap kalbaleb. Adok nag kupiyaves amisinap kalbaleb. Kwatimlakeigs miwotet bwein va̱gan bakin amisinap kweivaw nukukwawes, bwanabwein. Awoum kuninuways, kulansa, ‘Yakamey bwein, peinan Ebelam delen yakamey.’ Nag gog, Yowbad kadilok dakul tasiyas bivag mo bimlavags Ebelam delen. Ebelem delen mamagina kay. Tut kadilakus mo beiteiy kay kasiyas. Kukin amata kay nag beivag anagin mo beiteiy, bilev bein wa̱kov.”

Yon mo ilivan, ilana, “Yey, bo nabapta̱yseimiy yevagam waseg, peinan bo kulavewas amisinap kalbaleb. Igaw teitan beim, tatawtoun; yey nag kadilok ba̱kew inasandol, peinan guyaw avakaein. Mtowen beim mo bibapta̱yseimiy Kululuwan Bwanabwein waseg, mamagina kov. Mamagina nakaytuk wanaman biwaway anawit, va̱gan bikow anagin bwanabwein binow waseigous, simwan gog bisen bigigob kov tuta babaw.”
Wankuyeim Yeisuw mo ilisow Galiliy in Yoldan, inek Yon, va̱gan kid bibaptays.
Yon idok kid bisilbwed, ilana, “Kadilok kubapta̱yseig yey, awoum yey babapta̱yseim yak.”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Bweina kuvag nagein. Kadiloka sinap babaw bwanabwein bitayakous.” Mo itam.
Ibaptays Yeisuw ikous, iga̱lag, liba̱lab bo itavis, Yowbad Kululuwan mo ikin, ankakin ma̱wana bwabun italbelub im, iton Yeisuw wakunun.
Aygan teitan walba̱lab mo iligen, ilana, “Towen Natug bwanabwein; singay ibwein nanoug waseg.”
